questions.prompt: Between which two whole numbers does √70 lie?
What is the smallest number you must multiply 180 by to get a perfect square?
questions.explain: 180 = 2² × 3² × 5. The 5 has no partner, so multiply by 5: 900 = 30².

questions.prompt: What is the smallest number you must divide 252 by to get a perfect square?
A square field has an area of 1225 m². How much fencing is needed to go all the way around it?
questions.explain: Side = √1225 = 35 m, so the perimeter is 4 × 35 = 140 m.

questions.prompt: 2025 students stand in a square formation, with the same number in each row and column. How many are in each row?
Use “guess, divide, average” once to improve the guess 3 for √10. Show your working and check your answer.
questions.modelAnswer: 10 ÷ 3 = 3.333… The average of 3 and 3.333 is 3.1667. Check: 3.1667² ≈ 10.03, much closer to 10 than 3² = 9.
questions.explain: Criterion C: show clear, organised working.

questions.prompt: Which of these is irrational (its decimal never ends or repeats)?
questions.explain: 2 is not a perfect square, so √2 = 1.41421356… is irrational. √49 = 7, √0.25 = 0.5, √(9/16) = 3/4.
